subject: Dedicated capacity demo — FinFirm throughput & latency requirements
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia@finfirm.com>

Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: dedicated/reserved capacity demo for production traffic

Hi Monica and Vivek,

We signed up for Redwood's self-serve trial and are interested in discussing a Dedicated (reserved) capacity plan. We're hitting sustained peaks of ~4,000 req/s with p95 about 300ms today and are evaluating options to get p95 down to ~150–200ms while keeping costs predictable.

Key asks for the demo:
- Show Dedicated sizing guidance for sustained 4k req/s and burst headroom
- Example latency SLOs at different instance types and quantization settings
- Walkthrough of routing/fallback when capacity is constrained

I've attached a small export of our workload distribution (prod_workload_summary.csv) and a short note on peak windows. Can we schedule a 45–60m session that includes a short live perf test? We are PST-based, prefer afternoons.

Thanks,
Olivia Park
Head of Infrastructure, FinFirm
olivia@finfirm.com

Attachment: finfirm-prod-workload-summary.csv (CSV, 18KB)

Hi all — Stephanie from Solutions Engineering. Thanks for sending the workload export, Olivia — that helps a lot. A few quick technical requests so I can configure a demo that mirrors your traffic:

1) Can you share a 15–30 minute sample trace (anonymized) or request-rate over five-minute buckets? That helps pick batch sizes and KV cache policies.
2) What model family/sequence lengths are you testing (token lengths)? Are you using streaming responses or synchronous generation?
3) For the live perf test, we'd like a short, timeboxed synthetic that exercises your 99th/95th percentile request patterns — is Aaron comfortable providing a test key for a sandbox environment?

We'll prepare two baseline runs during the session to show (a) NVidia A100 quantized config and (b) Ampere/next-gen config with different batching profiles. Also looping in Markus for pricing/contracting context.

If Wed 11/17 3:30pm PST works, I'll provision a test pool and bring metrics dashboards.

— Stephanie
